input.summary: Make the liability cap the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000 for both parties, exclude Company's payment obligations, and add standard uncapped carve-outs.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have set the cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000 for both parties and carved out confidentiality, data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, since indemnities and confidentiality breaches must sit outside the cap. We have also confirmed that our obligation to pay fees due is not itself capped; we can discuss a straight 12-month fee cap if the fixed floor is an issue.

ops.oldText: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES. COMPANYS' MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO CONTRACTOR FOR ANY REASON ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR.
ops.newText: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO EXCLUDED CLAIMS AND CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, EACH PARTY'S MAXIMUM AGGREGATE LIABILITY TO THE OTHER PARTY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE GREATER OF (I) THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID OR PAYABLE TO CONTRACTOR UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (II) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (USD 1,000,000). COMPANY'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES AND EXPENSES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.

ops.text: "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS, NONE OF WHICH SHALL BE SUBJECT TO ANY LIMITATION OF LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT.
